public_page.browser_title: PhD Renovation: Program Understanding via Constraint Satisfaction
public_page.title: PhD Renovation
public_page.summary: A living restoration of Steven Woods' PhD research code on automated program understanding via constraint satisfaction, rebuilt to run on modern SBCL while preserving the published thesis-result story and the broader historical solver lineage.

cards.title: Primary goal
cards.summary: Re-establish one integrated constraint-solver line that reproduces the PhD results, covers other historical result families, and can stand in as the gold-standard codebase.

cards.title: What is already solid
cards.summary: All four maintained historical solver snapshots load on SBCL. The thesis ij2 / ij3 / ij4 validation path is executable and CI-protected. AO baseline assertions include the legacy test4 wrappers, ff provenance is checked, and both the older ADT archive and the earliest DREV-era T-series archive are now integrity-checkable.

cards.title: What M1 means
cards.summary: qcsp3 becomes the first real integrated line when it holds the PhD baseline, the asserted AO baseline, and the documented ff relationship under one supported executable story, with blocked terrain recovery tracked separately.

public_page.footer: Public summary synced to the repository status on March 21, 2026.
